description: Single fact source for the current installed-agent collaboration interface. Runtime Click commands must anchor to this registry; catalog-only adjacent controls must not appear in agent docs unless declared here.

apis.name: kungfu agent
apis.purpose: Agent-facing local Kungfu discovery entrypoint.

apis.name: kungfu agent brief
apis.purpose: Print the local onboarding brief.

apis.name: kungfu agent docs
apis.purpose: List installed Agent documents and expose the Xinfa context-discovery boundary.

apis.name: kungfu agent capabilities --json
apis.purpose: Print the machine-readable pack index, command catalog, and KFD-3 registry summary.

apis.name: kungfu agent work-model --json
apis.purpose: Read the public Pursuit, Atlas, Warrant, and Episode contract, current implementation mappings, invalid inferences, and P17 qualification debt.

apis.name: kungfu agent work
apis.purpose: Use the KFD-7 Kungfu Product Profile without replacing Fact or Episode authority.

apis.name: kungfu agent work capabilities --json
apis.purpose: Discover two ontology bindings, three Action Geometry mappings, Domain Profile transitions, typed denials, and authority boundaries.

apis.name: kungfu agent work session --operation <compressibility|expand|project> --file <session.json> --json
apis.purpose: Round-trip a simple work session through the five KFD-7 Profile roles or expose the exact role at a complexity breakpoint.

apis.name: kungfu agent work inspect --ref <ref> --json
apis.purpose: Resolve one exact Fact ref and report all five Profile role identities, states, relations, and typed gaps.

apis.name: kungfu agent work action --file <request.json> [--execute] --json
apis.purpose: Plan or execute one Profile transition through the shared action/receipt contract and native Fact ref CAS.

apis.name: kungfu agent work export-authority --json
apis.purpose: Export a content-bound native Fact authority bundle that preserves exact Profile object, version, Cut, and ref roots.

apis.name: kungfu agent work import-authority --file <bundle.json> [--execute] --json
apis.purpose: Validate or replay one qualified Fact authority bundle into a clean runtime home without changing logical Profile roots.

apis.name: kungfu agent choose-mode --json
apis.purpose: Choose brief, report, atlas-projection, trace, managed-run, or remote-sync from explicit flags.

apis.name: kungfu agent console
apis.purpose: Inspect the content-bound identity and public entrypoints of the current Kungfu Agent Console attempt.

apis.name: kungfu agent console current --json
apis.purpose: Validate and return the current Console, attempt, Runtime Profile, optional WorkRef, installed Profile roots, entrypoints, limits, and envelope root.

apis.name: kungfu agent session <operation> --input - --json
apis.purpose: Invoke list/show/plan-start/start/attach/detach/status/snapshot/plan-control/acquire-control/release-control/instruct/send-key/interrupt/end through the same AgentSessionCapsule action port used by the GUI.

apis.name: kungfu agent runtime
apis.purpose: Discover and configure machine-local Codex and Claude launch profiles without reading provider credentials.

apis.name: kungfu agent runtime discover --json
apis.purpose: List every safe executable Codex and Claude candidate from PATH and explicit known locations.

apis.name: kungfu agent runtime list --json
apis.purpose: Show configured, discovered, default, and recommended Agent Runtime Profiles.

apis.name: kungfu agent runtime upsert --id <id> --provider <provider> --executable <path> --json
apis.purpose: Preview or explicitly add or edit one executable-plus-argv Agent Runtime Profile.

apis.name: kungfu agent runtime remove <profile-id> --json
apis.purpose: Preview or explicitly remove one machine-local launch profile without deleting work facts or Console history.

apis.name: kungfu agent runtime set-default <profile-id> --json
apis.purpose: Preview or explicitly select the machine-global default Agent Runtime Profile.

apis.name: kungfu agent runtime verify <profile-id> --json
apis.purpose: Run a bounded executable --version probe for one Agent Runtime Profile.

apis.name: kungfu agent install-skill --target codex
apis.purpose: Preview or explicitly copy a provider skill file.

apis.name: kungfu agent status --target codex --json
apis.purpose: Show local bootstrap mode, report closeout gate, and policy path.

apis.name: kungfu agent bootstrap --target codex --mode report
apis.purpose: Preview or apply a provider bootstrap policy and optional skill install.

apis.name: kungfu agent mode
apis.purpose: Preview or apply an agent mode switch.

apis.name: kungfu agent mode set --target codex --mode managed-run
apis.purpose: Switch a provider between report, managed-run, trace, brief, or remote-sync policy modes.

apis.name: kungfu agent unbootstrap --target codex
apis.purpose: Disable bootstrap policy without deleting receipts, work items, or copied skills.

apis.name: kungfu agent uninstall --target codex
apis.purpose: Show complete uninstall steps; dry-run by default and no data deletion.

apis.name: kungfu agent context --json
apis.purpose: Print the canonical local discovery context.

apis.name: kungfu agent verify --json
apis.purpose: Verify the installed agent-first KFD-3 collaboration-interface closure.

apis.name: kungfu trace -- <command>
apis.purpose: Capture an existing command into a local Rewind trace.

apis.name: kungfu managed-run --provider <provider> --prompt <task>
apis.purpose: Run a provider CLI under Kungfu supervision and capture it into an explicit, discovered, or no-project Home workspace with a receipt.

apis.name: kungfu workspace inspect --home --json
apis.purpose: Inspect a Home or project workspace candidate without initializing it.

apis.name: kungfu workspace catalog --json
apis.purpose: List, verify, bounded-rebuild, or exact-rebind machine-local workspace locators without scanning or changing workspace authority.

apis.name: kungfu workspace work --scope <local|related|all> [--from-ref <work-ref.json> --direction <forward|backward|both>] --json
apis.purpose: Read Initiative and Assignment work with per-component observation/cut proof and optionally traverse typed relations from an exact WorkRef without creating workspace state.

apis.name: kungfu workspace graph-qualify --from <relations.json> --json
apis.purpose: Verify exact Assignment WorkRefs, relation roots, and relation-specific cycle constraints.

apis.name: kungfu assignment relation-event --relation <relation.json> --event <event> --actor <actor>
apis.purpose: Append one idempotent cross-workspace relation handshake fact to the exact endpoint-owning workspace.

apis.name: kungfu workspace pull --source-runtime <path> --destination-runtime <path> --episode-id <id> --json
apis.purpose: Plan or execute destination-initiated Episode Admission through the shared native admission protocol.

apis.name: kungfu workspace push --source-runtime <path> --destination-runtime <path> --episode-id <id> --json
apis.purpose: Propose source-initiated Episode Admission while preserving destination authority and the shared native receipt.

apis.name: kungfu workspace ensure <path> --reason start-continuation --json
apis.purpose: Create local runtime authority only after explicit continuation intent; a shadow-only inspection never invokes this action.

apis.name: kungfu workspace request-full-evidence <path> --json
apis.purpose: Produce an exact read-only request for full Episode evidence missing from a settled Git shadow.

apis.name: kungfu workspace import-full-evidence <path> --from <bundle> [--execute] --json
apis.purpose: Validate or explicitly import a full Episode bundle whose semantic root is already bound by settled history.

apis.name: kungfu workspace advise --home --source <path> --json
apis.purpose: Return deterministic evidence-backed project-workspace advice without changing state.

apis.name: kungfu workspace preview --home --source <path> --intent create-project-workspace --json
apis.purpose: Preview exact workspace effects, skipped Git effects, freshness cut, and authorization class.

apis.name: kungfu workspace authorize --home --source <path> --intent create-project-workspace --preview-id <id> --decision approve --authorized-by <actor> --json
apis.purpose: Record one bounded decision for the exact current preview; mismatched or stale agent input fails closed.

apis.name: kungfu workspace apply --home --source <path> --authorization-id <id> --json
apis.purpose: Execute one approved idempotent workspace intent and reject stale previews or denied authority.

apis.name: kungfu workspace verify --home --receipt-id <id> --json
apis.purpose: Verify a workspace action receipt against its authorization and resulting filesystem effects.

apis.name: kungfu storage import --from <episode-bundle.json> --execute --json
apis.purpose: Validate then capture an Episode into an explicit, discovered, or no-project Home workspace and return its Inbox receipt.

apis.name: kungfu exit build --file <request.json> --json
apis.purpose: Compose, inspect, validate, or explicitly import one scope-bound Exit package through the shared Core receipt path.

apis.name: kungfu-exit-verify --file <package.json> --json
apis.purpose: Run the bounded read-only installed Exit verifier without initializing a runtime; report safe capabilities, omissions, loss, failure codes, and residual risk.

apis.name: kungfu cut --repo <path> --json
apis.purpose: Inspect the current Project Cut, confidence, gaps, and exact next actions without initializing runtime state.

apis.name: kungfu work capabilities --json
apis.purpose: Discover the shared high-level Work and Cut operations, current availability, authority boundaries, and per-surface parity.

apis.name: kungfu work inspect --repo <path> --json
apis.purpose: Inspect the current Cut and open Work through one non-authoritative read model.

apis.name: kungfu work export <work-id> --repo <path> --json
apis.purpose: Export one byte-stable Work continuity envelope bound to the exact verified current Project Cut.

apis.name: kungfu work import --file <envelope.json> --repo <path> [--execute] --json
apis.purpose: Verify or explicitly append only the missing prefix of one Project Cut-bound portable Work envelope.

apis.name: kungfu work recover --repo <path> --json
apis.purpose: Classify the exact next Work or Cut recovery action without changing state.

apis.name: kungfu work complete <work-id> --repo <path> --json
apis.purpose: Prepare a completion candidate and disclose missing evidence without self-settling Work.

apis.name: kungfu work settle <work-id> --claim-root <root> --review-root <root> --decision-root <root> --project-cut-root <root> --json
apis.purpose: Prepare a root-bound settlement plan while preserving independent review and explicit Project Cut publication authority.

apis.name: kungfu work create <title> --json
apis.purpose: Create structured work facts in the local journal.

apis.name: kungfu report run begin --work <work-id> --provider <provider> --json
apis.purpose: Open a reported external agent run without changing how the agent is launched.

apis.name: kungfu report cost --run <run-id> --provider <provider> --json
apis.purpose: Append reported token and cost facts to a run journal.

apis.name: kungfu report run end --run <run-id> --status <status> --json
apis.purpose: Close a reported external run and refresh its manifest.

apis.name: kungfu codex report-goal --goal-id <goal-id> --status <status> --json
apis.purpose: Report a native Codex goal into Kungfu work/Rewind facts and emit a receipt.

apis.name: kungfu codex verify-goal-report --receipt <path> --json
apis.purpose: Verify a Codex goal report receipt before closeout.

apis.name: kungfu atlas import --repo <atlas-repo> --json
apis.purpose: Snapshot an Atlas-style control-plane repo into Kungfu's local read-only projection.

apis.name: kungfu atlas authority-status --source <source> --json
apis.purpose: Show exact Atlas bridge parity and the current single Mission/Go write authority.

apis.name: kungfu atlas authority-cutover --expected-parity-root <root> --project-cut-root <root> --atlas-root <root> --actor <actor> --reason <reason> --json
apis.purpose: Append a parity-bound authority receipt and freeze Atlas Mission/Go mutation read-only.

apis.name: kungfu atlas authority-rollback --expected-migration-id <id> --actor <actor> --reason <reason> --json
apis.purpose: Append an exact rollback receipt, restore Atlas mutation, and retain native facts read-only.

apis.name: kungfu atlas create-mission <mission-id> --title <title> --intent <intent> --actor <actor> --json
apis.purpose: Create a Kungfu-native long-running Mission in the shared Fact Library.

apis.name: kungfu atlas export-mission <mission-id> --out <bundle.json> --mode <full|thin> --json
apis.purpose: Export a bounded Mission closure with proof coordinates and full or thin Episode material.

apis.name: kungfu atlas import-mission --from <bundle.json> [--execute] --json
apis.purpose: Verify a portable Mission bundle and explicitly materialize full closures while thin bundles remain degraded references.

apis.name: kungfu atlas assess-mission <mission-id> --json
apis.purpose: Query admitted Mission/Go facts and persist a purpose-bound progress TrustReport.
Create a Kungfu-native Go with separate containment and execution dependencies plus exact verified Xinfa context, Atlas, Project Cut, Episode, responsibility, and acceptance roots.
Record a versioned root-bound completion claim over a Go set, Atlas transition, Project Cut, Git object, Episodes, proofs, evidence availability, and known gaps.

apis.name: kungfu atlas assess-completion <mission-id> <goal-id> --json
apis.purpose: Assess a Go completion claim for a declared purpose and fail closed on missing evidence.

apis.name: kungfu atlas review-completion <mission-id> <goal-id> --reviewer <actor> --reviewer-source <source> [--checkout <path>] [--source <source>] [--purpose <purpose>] [--cut-system-time <ns>] [--executor <profile>] [--follow-up <json>] --json
apis.purpose: Independently review one exact completion claim, emit an Assessment Episode and purpose-bound TrustReport, and seal a deterministic continuation plan.

apis.name: kungfu atlas decide-continuation <mission-id> <goal-id> <review-id> --expected-review-root <root> --expected-plan-root <root> --action <action> --actor <actor> [--actor-type <type>] [--change-class <class>] [--source <source>] --reason <reason> --json
apis.purpose: Apply one exact-root continuation decision and materialize only bounded mechanical follow-up Go rows while preserving human gates for mission, authority, privacy, security, public claims, and irreversible changes.

apis.name: kungfu atlas show import --json
apis.purpose: Show the latest Atlas projection batch metadata and source repo head.

apis.name: kungfu atlas show missions --json
apis.purpose: List admitted Atlas and Kungfu-native Mission facts from the selected data root.

apis.name: kungfu atlas show goals --json
apis.purpose: List imported Atlas goal cards from the latest projection.

apis.name: kungfu atlas show markers --json
apis.purpose: List imported Atlas worktree-status markers from the latest projection.

apis.name: kungfu health --json
apis.purpose: Run the bounded read-only runtime, Peer, storage, and Episode preflight and return actionable problems with stable exit semantics.

apis.name: kungfu health --deep --json
apis.purpose: Add the complete read-only storage fsck and open-Episode recovery-plan inspection to the shared health report.

apis.name: kungfu storage status --scope all --json
apis.purpose: Inspect source manifests, accepted cursors, sync roots, and storage projection status.

apis.name: kungfu storage fsck --scope all --json
apis.purpose: Verify generic storage manifests, payload hashes, source registry drift, and orphan payload candidates.

apis.name: kungfu storage repair --scope episode --episode-id <id> --plan --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Convert degraded storage and Episode fsck diagnostics into machine-readable repair candidates without mutating facts.

apis.name: kungfu storage repair --scope episode --episode-id <id> --fetch --out repair-material.json --dry-run --json

apis.name: kungfu storage repair --scope episode --episode-id <id> --apply --from <bundle.json> --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Validate local repair material and preview Episode manifest or payload restoration; use --execute only for explicit writes.

apis.name: kungfu storage rebuild-index --scope all --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Preview or rebuild the derived source registry from accepted latest manifests.

apis.name: kungfu storage gc --scope all --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Plan unreachable payload garbage collection without deleting payloads.

apis.name: kungfu storage compact --scope all --dry-run --json
apis.purpose: Plan fact-ledger compaction without archiving, deleting, vacuuming, or rewriting facts.

apis.name: kungfu storage verify-sync --source <source-id> --json
apis.purpose: Simulate manifest-backed local export/import/fsck and compare sync roots.

apis.name: kungfu storage query --table entries --scope source --source <source-id> --json
apis.purpose: Query C++-owned SQLite storage projection rows without reading SQLite directly from bindings.

apis.name: kungfu query schema --json

apis.name: kungfu query describe episodes --json

apis.name: kungfu query examples --json
apis.purpose: Print runnable head and exact historical-cut QueryDefinition examples.

apis.name: kungfu query validate --file query.json --json

apis.name: kungfu query explain --file query.json --json

apis.name: kungfu query prove --file query.json --json

apis.name: kungfu query changelog --file query.json --json

apis.name: kungfu query saved-view --file saved-view.json --json

apis.name: kungfu query saved list --json
apis.purpose: Manage the workspace-local journal-backed saved query catalog shared by CLI, GUI, and agents.

apis.name: kungfu facts import --file <bundle.json> [--execute]
